question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dff3c6199176b6d2ba8104e36713afa34fd7ce5f26f76e420d8e2dc05c67429.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The pattern is based on a complete 180-degree rotation of the box, where each element shifts to the diagonally opposite position. The top-left element moves to bottom-right, top-right moves to bottom-left, bottom-left moves to top-right, and bottom-right moves to top-left, while the middle elements also swap correspondingly across the center.

By tracking the movement of each symbol, it is clear that the entire arrangement is flipped both vertically and horizontally in a single transformation step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caf6ef999ed3a3c1c70b089867f0066e8fd23088ddcbf9ac0c270da7d01b8c41.png] 

Applying the same 180-degree rotation to the given third box, each symbol moves to its opposite position, preserving the structure but reversing spatial placement.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
